subject: SOC 2 Type II: management response + bridge letter and evidence pack for CorpGate
messages:
From: Martin Cole <martin.cole@corpgate.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — findings we need response for

Hi Ben / Laura,

Thanks for sharing the SOC 2 Type II report draft earlier. Our security intake flagged two items in the control exceptions section that we need formal management responses and evidence for before we can proceed with the onboarding:

1) Infrequent documentation of quarterly user access recertifications (finding ID: RW-AUTH-2026-03) — auditor notes a gap in April review.
2) Backup retention variance — a single backup chain for our eu-prod region showed retention less than the documented 90 days (finding ID: RW-BCK-2026-07).

Can Redwood provide: (a) a management response for each finding, (b) a bridge letter if remediation is ongoing, and (c) supporting artifacts (access review logs, backup job logs/policy). Our deadline to close is EOD Aug 20. If you can get a draft and evidence by Aug 16 we will route to our auditors (Thompson & Clyne) immediately.

Appreciate the help — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Martin Cole
InfoSec Lead — CorpGate

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Martin Cole <martin.cole@corpgate.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II — findings we need response for

Team — forwarding CorpGate's ask (below). TL;DR: two findings, they need management responses, bridge letter if we haven't closed remediation, and supporting artifacts by Aug 16 ideally (deadline Aug 20).

Monica — can you draft management responses for both findings? For the access recert, outline the steps we took, the owner who performed the April review, and the concrete remediation plan and expected completion date. For the backup retention variance, can you confirm whether this was a config drift or reporting/labeling issue and pull the backup job logs for the affected container(s)?

Rishi — please review any suggested wording for the bridge letter (legal sign-off). Laura — please coordinate communications with CorpGate; Ben will stay involved for scope/SLAs.

If anyone can't meet Aug 16, call it out now — we need to avoid delays.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Martin Cole <martin.cole@corpgate.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 Type II — findings we need response for

Hi all — attaching the draft management response and a proposed bridge letter for CorpGate (see attachments: redwood_soc2_mgmt_response_20260815.pdf, bridge_letter_corpgate_20260815.pdf). High-level summary below:

- RW-AUTH-2026-03 (user access recertifications): Root cause — scheduling & owner handoff between identity team and platform ops resulted in April's recert being kicked to a secondary reviewer and not captured in the central log. Management response: we performed a retrospective recert for the April window (owner: A. Kaur, identity team) and documented the reviewer, time, and changes. Remediation: automated calendar-based reminders and an ownership SLA; full automation of recert reminders planned for completion by 2026-09-10. Evidence included: retrospective recert report (summary table) and a timestamped export (attached as user_access_remediation_log_20260817.csv).

- RW-BCK-2026-07 (backup retention variance): Root cause — a scripted retention label did not propagate to one eu-prod backup job after a rolling deploy; retention job re-applied successfully on Aug 12. Management response: we re-queued the retention job, confirmed retention to 90 days for the affected chain, and updated the backup policy doc. Remediation: add monitoring alert for retention drift and a weekly validation job (deployed 2026-08-16). Evidence attached: backup_policy_update_20260816.md and job logs (excerpt included).

Per Rishi we have preliminary legal language in the bridge letter; Rishi, can you confirm and sign off? Once legal approves we can send both docs and the evidence pack to Martin and Sara.

Notes: the attachments are intentionally narrow: mgmt response, bridge letter, log export, backup policy note. If auditors need raw job traces we can export them but I'd prefer to start with the artifacts above.

Thanks — Monica
Manager, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_mgmt_response_20260815.pdf (management response), bridge_letter_corpgate_20260815.pdf (draft bridge letter), user_access_remediation_log_20260817.csv (retrospective recert export), backup_policy_update_20260816.md (policy update)

From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@tc-audit.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Martin Cole <martin.cole@corpgate.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 Type II — findings we need response for

Monica / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft materials. A few clarifying requests from the audit team before we mark the exceptions as "management responses accepted":

1) For the access recertification: we need the CSV export to include reviewer name, review timestamp, and the list of users removed/changed during the recert (if any). The file you attached looks like a summary; can you provide the full export for the April recert (redact only personal identifying contact info if necessary)?
2) For the backup retention: we require the retention job log showing the re-application event (UTC timestamps) and a snapshot of the retention policy change in source control (commit ID or PR link).

If you can provide those two items by Aug 18 EOD we'll take the bridge letter under consideration and update our opinion to CorpGate. If you need more time, notify us and give the expected delivery date.

Regards,
Sara Thompson
Senior Auditor, Thompson & Clyne

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Martin Cole <martin.cole@corpgate.com>, Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@tc-audit.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 Type II — findings we need response for (evidence pack attached)

Hi Martin / Sara — thanks for the fast review. Per Monica's notes we have pulled the requested artifacts and are attaching the items Sara requested:

- user_access_remediation_log_20260817.csv — full export with reviewer name, review timestamp (UTC), and the delta list for the April recert.
- backup_job_reapply_log_20260812.txt (excerpt included in the Drive link) and backup_policy_update_20260816.md — includes the PR link for the retention policy change.
- redwood_soc2_mgmt_response_20260815.pdf and bridge_letter_corpgate_20260815.pdf (finalized with Rishi's legal sign-off).

Summary: the access recert retrospective completed Aug 13 (reviewer: A. Kaur). The backup retention job re-applied on Aug 12 and retention validated to 90 days for the affected chain on Aug 13. We have deployed the weekly validation check and an alert for retention drift (monitoring rule id: MON-RET-0029).

Next steps: if Sara / Thompson & Clyne accept these artifacts, please confirm by Aug 20 so CorpGate's intake can proceed. If you'd like a 20–30 minute walk-through of the artifacts I can set up a call tomorrow morning.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: user_access_remediation_log_20260817.csv, redwood_soc2_mgmt_response_20260815.pdf, bridge_letter_corpgate_20260815.pdf, backup_policy_update_20260816.md
